source_document.title: Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Terrorism Financing and Proceeds of Unlawful Activities Act 2001
source_document.excerpt: A reporting institution shall conduct customer due diligence.

description: Policy outlining the standard procedures for identifying and verifying customers for individual accounts.

requirements.text: Obtain full name, NRIC/Passport number, and residential address.
Verify identity documents against original or certified true copies.
Screen customer against UN Security Council Resolutions and MOHA sanction lists.

obligations.detailed_text: The institution must ensure that the customer's identity is verified using reliable, independent source documents.

internal_controls.name: New Account KYC Check
internal_controls.description: Automated check of ID format and validity upon data entry.

internal_controls.name: Daily Sanctions Screening
internal_controls.description: Batch screening of entire customer base against updated sanction lists.

record_keeping.storage_requirements: Digital encrypted storage with audit trail.

exceptions.conditions: Wallet limit below RM 200 and total monthly transaction value below RM 1,000.

risk_indicators.name: Politically Exposed Person (PEP) Match
risk_indicators.description: Customer name matches a known PEP list.

risk_indicators.name: High Risk Country Connection
risk_indicators.description: Nationality or address linked to FATF high-risk jurisdictions.
